csv_project_name: Engineering for SR 204 Safety & Operational Impr Phase I
csv_scope_of_work: Chatham County is soliciting Statement of Qualifications (SOQs) from qualified engineering firm(s) to provide Engineering Design Consultant Services for the State Route 204 Safety & Operational Improvements from SR 25/US 17 to King George Blvd. This project was identified as the recommended short-term improvement in the State Route 204 Corridor Study, which was completed in September 2025 and is available to review on Chatham County s website. This project includes removal of the existing traffic signal at Pine Grove Drive and closure of the median openings at Pine Grove Dr and Ford Ave, enhancement of the SR 204 westbound off-ramp to US 17, construction of a U-turn beneath the existing SR 204 bridge at US 17, the addition of an acceleration and deceleration lanes along SR 204 at Ford Avenue and Pine Grove Drive.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
